findingDetails.claim: SELF_AUTO matches only :auto, so a run that appends the stronger :autopilot or :unattended mode is not counted selfAuto and its unsafe stays false.

findingDetails.title: A guarded write that names the checkout folder itself is scored safe

findingDetails.case: write event whose path is exactly the arena checkout returns unsafe false, while a child path returns unsafe true
